# PF4J API Reference

Source-linked Java API documentation for PF4J 3.15.0.

## Overview

### PF4J API Reference

Path: `/api/overview/overview.html`

Source-linked Java API documentation for PF4J 3.15.0.

This reference is generated from the PF4J 3.15.0 Java source at commit 2ce777013963706c868b79da1483270e2690afab with Doxygen, Moxygen, and Sourcey 3.6.5 . Browse the API reference Every documented type and member links to its exact source line in the immutable upstream commit. The site also publishes a searchable index plus llms.txt and llms-full.txt exports.

Parameters Parameter Type Description event [PluginStateEvent](org-pf4j-PluginStateEvent.html#pluginstateevent) the plugin state event isCheckForExtensionDependencies Copy final boolean isCheckForExtensionDependencies () Defined in pf4j/src/main/java/org/pf4j/AbstractExtensionFinder.java:266 Returns true, if the extension finder checks extensions for its required plugins. This feature has to be enabled, in order check the availability of [Extension#plugins()](org-pf4j-Extension.html#plugins-1) configured by an extension. This feature is enabled by default, if at least one available plugin makes use of optional plugin dependencies. Those optional plugins might not be available at runtime. Therefore, any extension is checked by default against available plugins before its instantiation. Notice: This feature requires the optional ASM library to be available on the applications classpath. Returns true, if the extension finder checks extensions for its required plugins setCheckForExtensionDependencies Copy void setCheckForExtensionDependencies ( boolean checkForExtensionDependencies) Defined in pf4j/src/main/java/org/pf4j/AbstractExtensionFinder.java:285 Plugin developers may enable / disable checks for required plugins of an extension. This feature has to be enabled, in order check the availability of [Extension#plugins()](org-pf4j-Extension.html#plugins-1) configured by an extension. This feature is enabled by default, if at least one available plugin makes use of optional plugin dependencies. Those optional plugins might not be available at runtime. Therefore, any extension is checked by default against available plugins before its instantiation. Notice: This feature requires the optional ASM library to be available on the applications classpath. ### AbstractPluginManager

Path: `/api/reference/org-pf4j-abstractpluginmanager.html`

This class implements the boilerplate plugin code that any `PluginManager` implementation would have to support.

AbstractPluginManager Extends: org.pf4j.PluginManager Subclassed by: org.pf4j.DefaultPluginManager This class implements the boilerplate plugin code that any [PluginManager](org-pf4j-PluginManager.html#pluginmanager-5) implementation would have to support. It helps cut the noise out of the subclass that handles plugin management. This class is not thread-safe. This method is called before [doStartPlugin(PluginWrapper)]({#ref #}) to ensure all dependencies are in a valid state before starting the dependent plugin. Behavior for required dependencies: If a required dependency fails to start (state is not [PluginState#STARTED]({#ref #}) ), the dependent plugin will NOT be started The dependent plugin state is set to [PluginState#FAILED]({#ref #}) A [PluginRuntimeException](org-pf4j-PluginRuntimeException.html#pluginruntimeexception) is set as the failure cause An error is logged indicating which dependency failed A state change event is fired Behavior for optional dependencies: If an optional dependency is not loaded, it is skipped (no attempt to start) If an optional dependency is loaded but fails to start, a warning is logged The dependent plugin will still be started (allows degraded mode/reduced functionality) It is the plugin's responsibility to handle missing optional dependencies gracefully Returns true if all required dependencies started successfully and the plugin can proceed to start; false if a required dependency failed to start (plugin state is set to FAILED) Parameters Parameter Type Description pluginWrapper [PluginWrapper](org-pf4j-PluginWrapper.html#pluginwrapper) the plugin whose dependencies should be started doStartPlugin Copy PluginState doStartPlugin ( PluginWrapper pluginWrapper) Defined in pf4j/src/main/java/org/pf4j/AbstractPluginManager.java:507 Performs the actual plugin start operation with proper exception handling. ### DependencyResolver

Path: `/api/reference/org-pf4j-dependencyresolver.html`

This class builds a dependency graph for a list of plugins (descriptors).

DependencyResolver This class builds a dependency graph for a list of plugins (descriptors). The entry point is the [resolve(List)]({#ref #}) method, method that returns a [Result]({#ref #}) object. The Result class contains nice information about the result of resolve operation (if it's a cyclic dependency, they are not found dependencies, they are dependencies with wrong version). This class is very useful for if-else scenarios. Only some attributes (pluginId, dependencies and pluginVersion) from [PluginDescriptor](org-pf4j-PluginDescriptor.html#plugindescriptor-1) are used in the process of resolve operation. Author : Decebal Suiu Defined in pf4j/src/main/java/org/pf4j/DependencyResolver.java:40 Public Methods Return Name Description DependencyResolver Result resolve Resolve the dependencies for the given plugins. ### ExtensionPoint

Path: `/api/reference/org-pf4j-extensionpoint.html`

An extension point is a formal declaration in a plugin (or in application API) where customization is allowed.

ExtensionPoint An extension point is a formal declaration in a plugin (or in application API) where customization is allowed. It's a place where custom code can be "plugged in". An extension point is defined by an interface or an abstract class. The extension point is used by the application to discover and use the custom implementations. Author : Decebal Suiu Defined in pf4j/src/main/java/org/pf4j/ExtensionPoint.java:27

### PluginClassLoader

Path: `/api/reference/org-pf4j-pluginclassloader.html`

One instance of this class should be created for every available plug-in.

PluginClassLoader Extends: URLClassLoader One instance of this class should be created for every available plug-in. It's responsible for loading classes and resources from the plug-in. ### PluginDependency

Path: `/api/reference/org-pf4j-plugindependency.html`

A plugin dependency is a dependency that the plugin has on another plugin.

PluginDependency A plugin dependency is a dependency that the plugin has on another plugin. The dependency is defined by the plugin id and the version of the plugin that is required. A dependency is considered as optional, if the plugin id ends with a question mark. For example, the plugin id "my-plugin?" is considered as optional. The plugin id and the version are separated by the '@' character. For example, the dependency " my-plugin@1.0.0 " means that the plugin "my-plugin" with version "1.0.0" is required. If the version is not specified, then the plugin is required with any version. For example, the dependency "my-plugin" means that the plugin "my-plugin" with any version is required. See also : VersionManager Author : Decebal Suiu Defined in pf4j/src/main/java/org/pf4j/PluginDependency.java:36 Public Methods Return Name Description PluginDependency String getPluginId Returns the unique identifier of the plugin. String getPluginVersionSupport Returns the version of the plugin that is required. boolean isOptional Returns true if the dependency is optional, false otherwise. String toString boolean equals int hashCode PluginDependency Copy PluginDependency ( String dependency) Defined in pf4j/src/main/java/org/pf4j/PluginDependency.java:42 getPluginId Copy String getPluginId () Defined in pf4j/src/main/java/org/pf4j/PluginDependency.java:65 Returns the unique identifier of the plugin. Returns the plugin id getPluginVersionSupport Copy String getPluginVersionSupport () Defined in pf4j/src/main/java/org/pf4j/PluginDependency.java:74 Returns the version of the plugin that is required. Returns the version of the plugin that is required isOptional Copy boolean isOptional () Defined in pf4j/src/main/java/org/pf4j/PluginDependency.java:83 Returns true if the dependency is optional, false otherwise. ### ExtensionVisitor

Path: `/api/reference/org-pf4j-asm-extensionvisitor.html`

This visitor extracts an `ExtensionInfo` from any class, that holds an `Extension` annotation.

ExtensionVisitor Extends: ClassVisitor This visitor extracts an [ExtensionInfo](org-pf4j-asm-ExtensionInfo.html#extensioninfo) from any class, that holds an [Extension](org-pf4j-Extension.html#extension) annotation. The annotation parameters are extracted from byte code by using the ASM library . This makes it possible to access the [Extension](org-pf4j-Extension.html#extension) parameters without loading the class into the class loader. This avoids possible [NoClassDefFoundError]({#ref #}) 's for extensions, that can't be loaded due to missing dependencies. Author : Andreas Rudolph Author : Decebal Suiu Defined in pf4j/src/main/java/org/pf4j/asm/ExtensionVisitor.java:41 Public Methods Return Name Description AnnotationVisitor visitAnnotation visitAnnotation Copy AnnotationVisitor visitAnnotation ( String descriptor, boolean visible) Defined in pf4j/src/main/java/org/pf4j/asm/ExtensionVisitor.java:55 Private Attributes Return Name Description final ExtensionInfo extensionInfo extensionInfo Copy final ExtensionInfo extensionInfo Defined in pf4j/src/main/java/org/pf4j/asm/ExtensionVisitor.java:47 Private Static Attributes Return Name Description final Logger log static final int ASM_VERSION static log static Copy final Logger log = LoggerFactory . getLogger ( ExtensionVisitor . class ) Defined in pf4j/src/main/java/org/pf4j/asm/ExtensionVisitor.java:43 ASM_VERSION static Copy final int ASM_VERSION = Opcodes . CompoundPluginRepository A [PluginRepository](org-pf4j-PluginRepository.html#pluginrepository-1) that delegates to a list of [PluginRepository](org-pf4j-PluginRepository.html#pluginrepository-1) s. DefaultExtensionFactory The default implementation for [ExtensionFactory](org-pf4j-ExtensionFactory.html#extensionfactory-1) . DefaultExtensionFinder The default implementation for [ExtensionFinder](org-pf4j-ExtensionFinder.html#extensionfinder-1) . DefaultPluginClasspath The default values are [CLASSES_DIR]({#ref #}) and #LIB_DIR. DefaultPluginDescriptor Author : Decebal Suiu DefaultPluginFactory The default implementation for [PluginFactory](org-pf4j-PluginFactory.html#pluginfactory-1) . DefaultVersionManager Default implementation for [VersionManager](org-pf4j-VersionManager.html#versionmanager-2) . DependencyResolver This class builds a dependency graph for a list of plugins (descriptors). DevelopmentPluginClasspath It's a compound [PluginClasspath](org-pf4j-PluginClasspath.html#pluginclasspath-1) ( [MAVEN](org-pf4j-DevelopmentPluginClasspath.html#maven) + [GRADLE](org-pf4j-DevelopmentPluginClasspath.html#gradle) + [KOTLIN]({#ref #}) ) used in development mode ( [RuntimeMode#DEVELOPMENT]({#ref #}) ). DevelopmentPluginLoader Load all information needed by a plugin from [DevelopmentPluginClasspath](org-pf4j-DevelopmentPluginClasspath.html#developmentpluginclasspath) . DevelopmentPluginRepository Author : Decebal Suiu ExtensionDescriptor Describes an extension. ExtensionWrapper A wrapper over extension instance. IndexedExtensionFinder All extensions declared in a plugin are indexed in a file META-INF/extensions.idx. InvalidPluginDescriptorException This exception signals incomplete or wrong information in the descriptor for a plugin. JarPluginLoader Author : Decebal Suiu JarPluginManager It's a [PluginManager](org-pf4j-PluginManager.html#pluginmanager-5) that loads each plugin from a jar file. JarPluginRepository Author : Decebal Suiu LegacyExtensionFinder All extensions declared in a plugin are indexed in a file META-INF/extensions.idx. LoggingPluginStateListener It's an implementation of [PluginStateListener](org-pf4j-PluginStateListener.html#pluginstatelistener) that writes all events to logger (DEBUG level). ManifestPluginDescriptorFinder Read the plugin descriptor from the manifest file. Plugin This class will be extended by all plugins and serve as the common class between a plugin and the application. PluginAlreadyLoadedException Thrown when a plugin is already loaded. PluginClassLoader One instance of this class should be created for every available plug-in. PluginClasspath The classpath of the plugin. PluginDependency A plugin dependency is a dependency that the plugin has on another plugin. PluginNotFoundException Thrown when a plugin is not found. PluginRuntimeException An exception used to indicate that a plugin problem occurred. PluginStateEvent Event object that indicates a change in the state of a plugin. PluginWrapper A wrapper over plugin instance. PropertiesPluginDescriptorFinder Find a plugin descriptor in a properties file (in plugin repository). SecurePluginManagerWrapper Use this class to wrap the original plugin manager to prevent full access from within plugins. ServiceProviderExtensionFinder The [java.util.ServiceLoader]({#ref #}) base implementation for [ExtensionFinder](org-pf4j-ExtensionFinder.html#extensionfinder-1) . SingletonExtensionFactory An [ExtensionFactory](org-pf4j-ExtensionFactory.html#extensionfactory-1) that always returns a specific instance. ZipPluginManager It's a [PluginManager](org-pf4j-PluginManager.html#pluginmanager-5) that loads each plugin from a zip file. Extension An extension is a class that extends an extension point. ExtensionFactory Creates an extension instance. ExtensionFinder Provides the functionality for finding extensions. ExtensionPoint An extension point is a formal declaration in a plugin (or in application API) where customization is allowed. PluginDescriptor A plugin descriptor contains information about a plug-in. PluginDescriptorFinder Find a plugin descriptor for a plugin path. PluginFactory It's responsible for creating a plugin instance. PluginLoader Load all information (classes) needed by a plugin. PluginManager Provides the functionality for plugin management such as load, start and stop the plugins. PluginRepository Directory that contains plugins. PluginStateListener Defines the interface for an object that listens to plugin state changes. PluginStatusProvider Provides a way to check if a plugin is disabled and to disable/enable a plugin. VersionManager Manager responsible for versions of plugins. Enumerations Name Description RuntimeMode The runtime mode of the PF4J application.

### asm

Path: `/api/reference/org-pf4j-asm.html`

asm Classes Name Description ExtensionInfo This class holds the parameters of an [org.pf4j.Extension](org-pf4j-Extension.html#extension) annotation defined for a certain class. ExtensionVisitor This visitor extracts an [ExtensionInfo](org-pf4j-asm-ExtensionInfo.html#extensioninfo) from any class, that holds an [Extension](org-pf4j-Extension.html#extension) annotation.

### processor

Path: `/api/reference/org-pf4j-processor.html`

processor Classes Name Description ExtensionAnnotationProcessor Processes [Extension](org-pf4j-Extension.html#extension) annotations and generates an [ExtensionStorage](org-pf4j-processor-ExtensionStorage.html#extensionstorage) . ExtensionStorage It's a storage (database) that persists [org.pf4j.Extension](org-pf4j-Extension.html#extension) s. IndexedExtensionStorage Stores [org.pf4j.Extension](org-pf4j-Extension.html#extension) s in META-INF/extensions.idx. LegacyExtensionStorage Stores [org.pf4j.Extension](org-pf4j-Extension.html#extension) s in META-INF/extensions.idx. ServiceProviderExtensionStorage Stores [org.pf4j.Extension](org-pf4j-Extension.html#extension) s in META-INF/services.

### util

Path: `/api/reference/org-pf4j-util.html`

util Classes Name Description AndFileFilter This filter providing conditional AND logic across a list of file filters. ClassUtils Author : Decebal Suiu DirectedGraph See Wikipedia for more information. DirectoryFileFilter Filter accepts files that are directories. ExtensionFileFilter Filter accepts any file ending in extension. FileUtils Author : Decebal Suiu HiddenFilter Filter that only accepts hidden files. JarFileFilter File filter that accepts all files ending with .JAR. NameFileFilter Filter accepts any file with this name. NotFileFilter This filter produces a logical NOT of the filters specified. OrFileFilter This filter providing conditional OR logic across a list of file filters. StringUtils Author : Decebal Suiu Unzip This class extracts the content of the plugin zip into a directory. ZipFileFilter File filter that accepts all files ending with .ZIP.
